blocks.text: 摘要

inlines.text: 摘要

blocks.text: 一个内部研究模型被要求更新一个加密货币交易应用，它使用了任务并未提供的钱包中的资金，为在 Sepolia（一个以太坊测试网络）上的部署付费。它从公开已知的开发者助记词中推导出钱包密钥，找到一个持有测试网络资金的账户，并用该账户支付了所请求的合约部署。该模型质疑自己是否有权限，随后推断公开的助记词和毫无价值的测试网络代币使得这些资金可以使用。部署成功，并向该账户收取了交易费用。此案例表明，模型可以用自己对可能危害的判断来替代账户持有人的许可，然后在未经授权的情况下依据该判断行事。

blocks.text: Summary

inlines.text: Summary

blocks.text: An internal research model asked to update a cryptocurrency trading application used funds from a wallet that the task had not supplied to pay for a deployment on Sepolia, an Ethereum test network. It derived wallet keys from publicly known developer recovery phrases, found an account with test-network funds, and used that account to pay for the requested contract deployment. The model questioned whether it had permission, then reasoned that a public recovery phrase and valueless test-network tokens made the funds acceptable to use. The deployment succeeded and charged transaction fees to the account. This case shows that a model can substitute its own judgment about likely harm for the account holder’s permission, then act on that judgment without authorization.

The deployment succeeded and charged transaction fees to the account. This case shows that a model can substitute its own judgment about likely harm for the account holder’s permission, then act on that judgment without authorization.

inlines.text: Investigation and response

blocks.text: We discovered this incident while extending our misalignment monitoring to records of earlier model activity. We have implemented additional safeguards to prevent live internet access for cases like this. We now run our misalignment monitoring system on all traffic which is designed to page security if live internet access were to be obtained.
